introHtml: Cotton nursing scrubs offer healthcare professionals a soft, breathable uniform that stands up to long shifts. Unlike synthetic blends, cotton allows skin to breathe, reducing irritation during 12-hour days. For bulk buyers, 100% cotton scrubs provide a classic, comfortable look that staff appreciate. Customize with embroidery or screen printing for a polished, professional appearance that reflects your facility’s commitment to quality care.
